infoLinks.content:

Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street.   • There will be no replacement buses at the following stops: Capitol Square, Paddy’s Markets, Exhibition Centre (towards The Star), and Pyrmont Bay.
L1 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am on Saturday 8 November.
 
See the news story for more detailed service information.

infoLinks.urlText: Major Event Buses operating for Oasis Live ’25 concerts at Olympic Park
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run for Oasis Live ‘25 concerts at Accor Stadium on Friday 7 and Saturday 8 November.  
 
Travel on Major Event Buses is included in the cost of your event ticket and services will run frequently. Attendees do not need to tap on and off, simply show your concert ticket to the driver when boarding buses.
